label: Lab 13
title: Does an agent company get better, measured blind?
question: When we fix our agents' instructions and tools, do their answers get better on work the fixes were not made on?
how: The same tasks, answered before and after the fixes. A separate AI reviewer judges each answer without being told which side wrote it. Two of the three sets of tasks were kept away from the fixing.
status: Judged by an AI, not a person
